title: Deno Is Joining Cloudflare
summary: Deno, the modern JavaScript/TypeScript runtime developed by Ryan Dahl (creator of Node.js), announces its joining or deep partnership with Cloudflare, a major edge computing and CDN company. This collaboration aims to bring Deno's secure-by-default runtime to Cloudflare's global edge network, enabling developers to run Deno applications on Cloudflare Workers and related infrastructure.
problem_solved: Provides a path for Deno to gain wider adoption and enterprise reach by leveraging Cloudflare's extensive edge computing infrastructure and global network.
why_valuable: This partnership enables developers to run secure, modern TypeScript code at the edge with native Cloudflare integration, combining Deno's developer-friendly design with Cloudflare's global infrastructure.
